findings.text: The two verses for sarkinos (G4560, fleshly), 2 Cor 3:3 (tablets of human hearts) and Heb 7:16 (bodily descent), both have inner-being value, from different perspectives.

The body as where fear and anguish show, through the hands: Jer 6:24; 50:43; Isa 13:7-8; Eze 7:17; 21:7; Jer 30:6; Zep 3:16; Neh 6:9; 2 Sam 4:1 (his courage failed, literally his hands dropped); Isa 35:3; Job 4:3; Heb 12:12; Lam 4:6; the flesh and body reading picks it up as the body's outward side.
